title: Zcash founder confirms a critical Orchard bug that could have created unlimited, undetectable counterfeit ZEC was live from May 2022 until it was patched June 1.
summary: Due to the pool's privacy, there is no way to prove whether it was ever exploited. A proposed network upgrade adding a new shielded pool + turnstile accounting, to let anyone verify the integrity of the ZEC supply. $ZEC fell ~25% on the disclosure.The bug that was undetected for ~4 years was found using Anthropic's Opus 4.8, released just days earlier, as part of an AI-assisted security audit. A flaw the world's best cryptographers missed, surfaced by a white-hat using a new AI model.Some argue this is the structural tradeoff of all private money, not a ZEC-specific failure. As X user @ robustus put it, you can't have both full privacy and fully transparent supply auditability in one system. Transparent chains like $BTC expose any inflation bug in the raw data; private chains can't. Zcash's turnstile accounting is designed to limit exactly this.Developing story. Shielded Labs to publish the upgrade proposal next week. More as it comes.Twitter

title: Gravity Bridge hacker deposits another $2.1M in ETH to Tornado Cash
summary: The hacker behind the Gravity Bridge exploit has deposited an additional 1,180 ETH, worth $2.06 million, into the crypto mixer Tornado Cash, CertiK reported. According to the blockchain security firm, this brings the total amount sent to Tornado Cash to 2,020 ETH, funneled through two externally owned accounts (EOAs). The funds are part of the 2,600 ETH, valued at $5.4 million at the time of the hack, stolen from the protocol. The remaining stolen assets have been distributed to multiple centralized exchanges (CEXs).
